page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m1 server family. Powered by the KVM hypervisor, this instance features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 4 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs). It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the underlying CPU lacks support for advanced instruction sets and hardware accelerators, such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA_NI). There are also no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance.

Due to the dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.m1.medium offers predictable compute performance for standard workloads. However, the absence of modern vector and cryptographic instruction sets represents a performance tradeoff for mathematical modeling, encryption-heavy tasks, or machine learning inference. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance is suitable for legacy applications, basic web serving, development environments, and general-purpose utility workloads that require a stable 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio without the premium cost of specialized hardware features.
